Projects

Things I've designed and built.

Delivering a finished seat to the family

September 2025 – Present

BlueLab EASE: Adaptive Seating

Designing adaptive seating devices that community builders in Nicaragua can manufacture locally. I'm on the León subteam.

  • Researched local manufacturing resources and material constraints alongside Nicaraguan stakeholders.
  • Modified 3D CAD models for custom seating, and built structural components with a band saw, miter saw, drill, and drill press.
  • Developing visual build plans and technical guides so the design is easier to mass-produce locally.
  • Onshape
  • 3D CAD
  • Fabrication
  • Human-centered design

The 10-LED heat map, from biased (red) to diverse (blue)

August – December 2025

Bias Spectrum Meter

A desktop meter that scores how biased a social media post is and shows it on a 10-LED heat map, from blue (diverse) to red (biased). Built with a team of four for ENGR 100.

  • My role: built the Author board, using an SN74HC244N buffer chip so several indicator LEDs could light at once without dimming or destabilizing the Arduino.
  • Created and circulated the survey that collected real social media feed data from classmates, and helped map how each bias flag feeds the final score.
  • The team scored posts across weighted categories like recency, popularity, beliefs, and author, using CMOS AND and NOT gates that matched our truth tables in testing.
  • Arduino Mega
  • CMOS logic
  • Tinkercad
  • Team of 4
View project poster
October 2026

Euchre Card Game

A four-player command-line Euchre game in C++ with AI and human players, built for EECS 280.

  • Implemented the full game loop: dealing, trump selection, trick-taking, and scoring.
  • Designed Card and Pack classes with overloaded comparison operators that account for trump and bowers.
  • Built an abstract Player base class with AI and human subclasses using inheritance and polymorphism.
  • C++
  • Object-oriented design
  • Polymorphism
April 2026

Galactic Route Planner

A C++ path-finding and data-cleaning program that generates navigation routes.

  • Parsed, cleaned, and validated input data using structs and string manipulation.
  • Applied a nearest-neighbor algorithm for step-by-step routes, exported as structured route logs.
  • C++
  • Algorithms
  • File I/O
March 2026

Hotel Review Analyzer

A C++ text-processing program that scores the sentiment of hotel reviews.

  • Read review and keyword data with file I/O, matching words to sentiment weights with parallel vectors.
  • Wrote scoring functions to calculate sentiment and classify each review.
  • C++
  • Text processing
  • File I/O
